scripts.build: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=512 rimraf dist && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=512 tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=512 PORT=8000 IS_DEV=1 NODE_ENV=development EXT_MODE=js KTLOG_SHOW_DEBUG=0 tsx watch src/main.ts
scripts.dev:ai: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=768 ENABLE_AI=1 PORT=8000 IS_DEV=1 NODE_ENV=development EXT_MODE=js KTLOG_SHOW_DEBUG=0 tsx watch src/main.ts
scripts.dev:collaboration: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=512 ENABLE_COLLABORATION=1 PORT=8000 IS_DEV=1 NODE_ENV=development EXT_MODE=js KTLOG_SHOW_DEBUG=0 tsx watch src/main.ts
scripts.smoke:memory: pnpm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=512 tsx scripts/memory-smoke.ts
scripts.typecheck: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=512 tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=512 tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
